description_en: Queries the page protection configuration of a site
description_zh: 查询站点页面保护配置
name: GetPageShield

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the ID by calling [ListSites](~~ListSites~~)
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可以通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version
